Description: airplane-systems static site: private S3 bucket behind CloudFront with Origin Access Control, and the view-rewrite CloudFront Function. Deploys run locally (scripts/deploy-aws.sh), so the stack holds no IAM resources. Create or change it through a reviewed change set.

AllowedAccountId.Description: The AWS account this stack may be created in (your own account id); a change set in any other account fails.

NoncurrentDays.Description: Days after which replaced (noncurrent) object versions expire.

PriceClass.Description: CloudFront edge locations (PriceClass_100 is North America and Europe, the cheapest).

ActiveReleaseId.Description: Preserve the current releases/<id> origin path on infrastructure updates; read it from CloudFront before creating a change set. Empty only for initial bootstrap.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Deploy this stack only in the account named by the AllowedAccountId parameter.

OriginAccessControlConfig.Description: CloudFront signs every request to the private site bucket.

CachePolicyConfig.Comment: HTML and other unhashed files: honours origin Cache-Control within 0-300 s, default 60 s.
